info.title: Companies API
info.description: The Companies API provides access to offices, organizational units and practice groups in the Tracker Company database.

get.summary: Get a company office with the provided identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The company office identifier.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Executes a request only if the passed ETag doesn't equal the current resource ETag (i.e. resource hasn't changed).

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Select properties to be returned, see [Select](http://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionselect)

200.description: A company office is successfully returned.

403.description: Caller does not have necessary permissions.

patch.summary: Update an organizational unit with the provided identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of an organizational unit to be updated.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Executes a request only if the passed ETag equals the current resource ETag (i.e. resource hasn't changed).

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description:
* return=representation: This is the default. The server includes an entity representing the current state of the resource. In response to a successful request a status of 200 would be returned.
* return=minimal: The response will not include the entity in the response. A successful request would result in a status of 204 to be returned.

requestBody.description: The model containing an organizational unit to be updated.

200.description: Returns the organizational unit that was updated.

204.description: Organizational unit was updated but will not be provided in response.

403.description: Caller does not have necessary permissions.

404.description: If the organizational unit is not found.
